integrity: Analytic identities and a deterministic symbolic checker; self-review only. No independent scientific audit and no blanket priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact global result only for scalar quadratics with equal finite proximal parameters; common-relaxation guarantee pointwise in concave curvature. Smooth nonquadratic example shows local instability, not all-trajectory divergence. Source small-stepsize convergence assumptions are not satisfied in the instability witness.
title: Sharp relaxation windows and two universal stability barriers for a four-operator splitting method
